title: Seam-Release Step from the Fresh State
statement: Let $M$ be a machine, let $a$ be one of its states, and let $c$ be a configuration for $M$ in state $a$. One step of the seam-release machine from the configuration obtained by renaming $c$'s state into the left summand gives the configuration obtained by taking one step of $M$ from $c$ and renaming the resulting state into the right summand.
